title: Contribution
description: A proposed change, identified by content digests rather than by any forge's number.

forge_ref.description: Where the contribution was observed. Informational only; verifiers must not decide from it.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who produced a contribution. An agent with no identified operator has no responsible party and must not clear a meaningful trust tier.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the issuing identity provider.

implementation.description: Agent implementation identifier. Required when kind is agent or pair.

operator.description: Human answerable for the agent's work. Required when kind is pair.

model.description: The model that produced the work, when known. Part of the durable triple standing attaches to; a harness that swaps models does not inherit standing.

delegation.description: The delegation chain that led to this actor, root first. A verifier MUST compute the effective tier as the minimum of `tier` and every ceiling, and MUST hold a chain with no answerable party at its root to unknown.

ceiling.description: The most standing this hop may hold. A cap, never a promotion.

grant.description: Identifier of the grant that created this hop. Informational only; verifiers must not decide from it.

key_binding.description: OIDC subject or public key the actor's signatures verify against. Absent means unauthenticated.
